title: The Dow Market Happenings For Thursday, October 25, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Thursday, October 25, 2018 Posted by admin on October 25th, Goldman Sachs (GS), IBM (IBM) and 3M +99 points.
Wednesday the Dow was down -608.01 (-2.41%) at 24,583.42.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -0.55%.
There were 5 Dow stocks up Wednesday.
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by Procter & Gamble (PG) +2.64%, Boeing (BA) +1.31% and Coca Cola (KO) +0.80%.
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by United Technologies (UTX) -6.11%, Microsoft (MSFT) -5.35% and Disney (DIS) -5.29%.
There were 17 Dow stocks down 2% or more Wednesday.
Microsoft (MSFT -5.35%) rallied nearly 5% in premarket trading after it reported Q1 EPS of $1.14, better than consensus of 96 cents.
Visa (V -3.49%) gained 2% in after-hours trading after it reported Q4 adjusted EPS of $1.21, better than consensus of $1.20.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
 two-tenths of a cent at $2.842 reported earnings on 10/24/2018 after the market close of $1.14, beating estimates of $1.007 per share.
Visa (V) reported earnings on 10/24/2018 after the market close of $1.21, missing estimates calling for $1.244 per share.
Merck (MRK) reported earnings on 10/25/2018 before the market open of $1.19, beating estimates calling for $1.167 per share.
